title: Hostname parser accepts netloc characters that NFKC-normalize into URL separators
source: Real-world defect (reconstruction): CPython urllib.parse.urlsplit pre-fix logic for CVE-2019-9636 (netloc characters that NFKC-normalize to separators misparse the host), fixed upstream by CPython commit 16e6f7dee7f02bb81aa6b385b982dcdda5b99286 (bpo-36216, GH-12201, first released in 3.7.3); the defective function is reconstructed standalone in this case, 2026-11-05

expected.title: Hostname parser accepts netloc characters that NFKC-normalize into URL separators
